_why: Routes that moved. Every entry keeps a URL that was published and indexed
resolving after a chapter changed owners.
`from` is the route as it was served, without the /playground/ baseUrl --
the plugin prepends it. `to` must resolve in the current build or the build
fails, which is the point: a redirect that rots is worse than none.
Append here when a chapter moves; never delete an entry, because the old
URL stays in somebody's history forever.
